verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows exact commands for installing the Azure CLI (e.g., brew install azure-cli) and a marketing line about quickly creating cloud apps. It contains no official quickstart that takes a developer from zero to a running deployed service with the exact deploy commands shown, and nothing evidences a first deploy in under an hour. Installing tooling is adjacent to the story, not the quickstart-to-running-service capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, first deploy is under an hour — official quickstarts that go from zero to a running service with the exact commands shown
